title: Private DR: add backup CronJobs + restore Job templates (secret mounts, resources, concurrency guardrails)
author: Diego Santos
release_notes: Private deployments: Helm chart adds optional scheduled backup CronJobs and one-shot restore Job templates with recommended resource requests/limits and secret mounts for storage credentials/KMS config.
body:
## Summary
This PR adds Helm chart primitives to support the Day-2 ops backup/restore toolkit for Redwood Private deployments:
- Scheduled backups via `CronJob` (one or more schedules)
- One-shot restore via `Job`
- Standardized secret mounts and env wiring for storage backends (S3/minio initially)
- Opinionated but overridable resource requests/limits + job timeouts
- Basic concurrency safeguards to avoid overlapping backups (more aggressive safeguards will follow in a separate PR)

This is intentionally “plumbing-only” for k8s operators: the actual logic is in `rw-private-dr` (installer repo) and is invoked via container args.

## Motivation
We need a repeatable way for Private operators to schedule backups (and to run restores during drills/incidents) without hand-authoring manifests. Helm is the common packaging layer for both VPC and on-prem installs, and it also provides a clean integration point for:
- secret mounts (credentials, customer KMS params)
- resource sizing guidance (avoid noisy-neighboring DB/control plane)
- explicit time windows / retries

## What’s included
### 1) Backup CronJob template
New template renders a `CronJob` when `privateDr.backup.enabled=true`.

Key behaviors:
- Uses `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` to prevent overlapping backups by default.
- Configurable `startingDeadlineSeconds`, `successfulJobsHistoryLimit`, `failedJobsHistoryLimit`.
- Supports "backup windows" via cron expression; actual recommended windows are documented in values comments.
- Runs the `rw-private-dr backup create` command with the chart-provided config.

Example (illustrative) snippet:

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redwood-private.fullname" . }}-backup
spec:
  schedule: {{ .Values.privateDr.backup.schedule | quote }}
  concurrencyPolicy: {{ .Values.privateDr.backup.concurrencyPolicy | default "Forbid" }}
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: {{ .Values.privateDr.backup.backoffLimit | default 1 }}
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: {{ include "redwood-private.backup.serviceAccountName" . }}
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers:
            - name: backup
              image: {{ include "redwood-private.drImage" . }}
              args:
                - "backup"
                - "create"
                - "--config=/etc/redwood-private-dr/config.yaml"
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dr-config
                  mountPath: /etc/redwood-private-dr
                - name: storage-creds
                  mountPath: /etc/redwood-private-dr/creds
                  readOnly: true

### 2) Restore Job template
New template renders a `Job` when `privateDr.restore.enabled=true`.

Notes:
- This is a one-shot job (not a CronJob). Operators can `helm upgrade --set privateDr.restore.enabled=true ...` and then disable afterwards.
- Includes explicit messaging in values comments that restore should be run during maintenance windows and coordinated with the control plane maintenance-mode toggles (implemented in redwood control plane / installer flows).
- Supports passing a restore “plan” artifact reference and/or backup ID (actual semantics owned by installer repo; chart only wires args/env).

### 3) Secret mounts and config
Adds a small “DR config” `ConfigMap` (non-secret) plus optional `Secret` references for storage credentials.

- `privateDr.storage.secretName` for S3/minio access keys (customer-provided)
- Optionally mounts a CA bundle secret for on-prem/minio TLS validation (`privateDr.storage.caBundleSecretName`)
- Everything is read-only mounts; no secret contents are templated by Helm.

### 4) Resource requests/limits guidance
Adds defaults intended to be conservative for control plane clusters:
- backup job requests: cpu 250m, mem 512Mi
- restore job requests: cpu 500m, mem 1Gi

These are overridable via `.Values.privateDr.backup.resources` and `.Values.privateDr.restore.resources`.

## Values added
- `privateDr.enabled` (umbrella)
- `privateDr.image.repository`, `privateDr.image.tag`, `privateDr.image.pullPolicy`
- `privateDr.backup.enabled`, `privateDr.backup.schedule`, `privateDr.backup.resources`, `privateDr.backup.concurrencyPolicy`, `privateDr.backup.backoffLimit`
- `privateDr.restore.enabled`, `privateDr.restore.args`, `privateDr.restore.resources`
- `privateDr.storage.type` (s3|minio|nfs placeholder), `privateDr.storage.secretName`, `privateDr.storage.caBundleSecretName`

## Files / charts touched
- charts/redwood-private/templates/private-dr/backup-cronjob.yaml
- charts/redwood-private/templates/private-dr/restore-job.yaml
- charts/redwood-private/templates/private-dr/dr-configmap.yaml
- charts/redwood-private/values.yaml (new section + extensive comments)
- charts/redwood-private/README.md (short section w/ enablement + safety notes)

## Testing
- `helm template` locally for:
  - backup only
  - restore only
  - both disabled
  - minio w/ custom CA bundle mount
- CI: chart lint + kubeconform against k8s 1.26/1.27 schemas

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Add PodDisruptionBudget and stronger anti-overlap safeguards + DB contention notes (tracked in ENG-4853; subsequent PR will handle).
- Add multi-schedule support (daily full + hourly PITR/WAL hooks) once installer side stabilizes.

## Review notes
Security: please pay attention to mount paths / readOnly, and confirm we are not accidentally rendering any secret data into a ConfigMap.
SRE: sanity check on default schedules and concurrency policy; I defaulted to Forbid.

---

### Review conversation (selected)

Rafael Mendes (requested changes): Can we default `concurrencyPolicy` to `Forbid` and make sure `startingDeadlineSeconds` is non-zero to avoid huge backlog catch-ups?

Diego Santos (author): Yep. Pushed commit 4 to default Forbid and set `startingDeadlineSeconds: 600` by default; still configurable.

Hanae Suzuki (requested changes): Please ensure secret mounts are readOnly and we don’t ever template access keys into values.yaml examples.

Diego Santos (author): Updated templates to enforce `readOnly: true` for the secret volumeMount. Removed any example values for keys; only references to secretName.

Allison Grant (comment): Can we add standard labels/annotations so dashboards can discover these jobs? At least `app.kubernetes.io/component=private-dr`.

Diego Santos (author): Added `app.kubernetes.io/component: private-dr` to CronJob/Job + pod template labels.

Connor O'Brien (approve): Looks good. Please keep restore job opt-in and off by default (so upgrades don’t suddenly create a job).

Diego Santos (author): Confirmed restore template gated behind `privateDr.restore.enabled` and defaults to false.

- lint (helm): PASS
- kubeconform (k8s 1.26): PASS
- kubeconform (k8s 1.27): PASS
- unit (chart tests): PASS

Squash merged to `main`.
